unit.why: A short dictum the rebbe spoke during the Simhat Torah hakafot (that hasidim come for the power of R. Zvi, not to honour him), followed by the compiler's remark on his humility. It has an occasion but no narrated event, so it is a saying in a numbered list of traits, not a story.
unit.boundary_note: part of a numbered series of sayings and traits (יג, יד, טו) about the same master
